requirements.text: Any operation requiring the user to supply a file name shall allow the user either to select the files from a list derived from files in the currently open application or to key in a file name, a relative path name, or a complete path name.
For any operation where the user is prompted to select from a list, the user shall be able to cancel the operation.
When collecting generated output files from HATS-SML, the HATS-GUI shall overwrite any file whose name is generated automatically.
Output pretty-printed text files and SDTs shall only be displayed when the user requests.
The main interface shall be menu driven.
The HATS-GUI shall allow the user to specify the number of levels of nodes to expand during SDT viewing.
The HATS-GUI shall allow the user to select the colors for types of displayed nodes in a displayed graph.
The HATS-GUI shall allow the user to select the shapes for types of displayed nodes in a displayed graph.

The HATS-GUI shall interface with HATS-SML (version 2.0) in order to parse transformation language programs, execute transformation language programs, and create output SDTs, error messages, pretty-printed text, and parsed transformation language programs.
The GUI shall allow the user to create, modify, copy, or delete applications or files regardless of the current status of HATS-SML.
The HATS-GUI shall be able to communicate with Sun Solaris, Linux, and Windows 2000.

The HATS-GUI shall allow a user to create an application minimally consisting of a lexical specification file, a grammar file, a user-defined functions file, and application configuration information.
All files associated with a given application shall be stored in one directory.
The system shall open a new window when the user selects to display output.
Display windows opened by the system shall have buttons for closing the windows.

When collecting generated output files from HATS-SML, the HATS-GUI shall prompt the user for confirmation before overwriting any existing file, unless the user has explicitly enabled an 'auto-overwrite' setting.
The HATS-GUI shall enforce file system permissions such that only authorized users can modify application configuration files and transformation outputs.
The system shall parse a transformation language program or target file of up to 10MB in size within 5 seconds on the target hardware.
The HATS-GUI shall implement file-level locking to prevent concurrent modification of application files by multiple instances of the GUI.
The system shall limit the number of concurrent output display windows to a maximum of 5, reusing existing windows for subsequent outputs.
The HATS-GUI shall detect the abnormal termination of a HATS-SML process and notify the user with an error log, while maintaining the integrity of the application configuration.
The system shall complete the parsing of a transformation language program or target file within 5 seconds for files up to 10MB in size.
The HATS-GUI shall be capable of rendering and navigating SDTs containing up to 100,000 nodes without exceeding 512MB of heap memory.
The HATS-GUI shall refresh the SDT display within 2 seconds of the completion of a transformation process.
The HATS-GUI shall support the concurrent execution of up to 5 background HATS-SML processes without degrading the responsiveness of the main GUI thread.
